principle: The envelope composes registered LEGO identities and their assumptions/guarantees. Domain-native payloads remain owned by their own contracts and are not flattened into a universal Capital object.

request.legoIds: ordered registered LEGO identities; R1 is a DAG path projection, not a workflow runtime
request.availableAuthorities: explicit authority classes supplied by the caller/environment; registry metadata cannot mint them
request.requestedUse: explicit use being composed so model/use restrictions can fail closed

nonClaims: does not grant provider or owner authority
does not establish evidence obligations as satisfied
